role: StoreKit 2 manager singleton: loads the lifetime-unlock and $0 30-day-trial products, runs purchase/trial/restore, sweeps Transaction.currentEntitlements into isPurchased/hasPurchasedProduct/hasTrialTransaction, verifies the AppTransaction environment, and exposes the trial clock and every non-purchase access route (beta tester, developer install, trial, debug grant).
types: StoreKitManager: final class (@Observable, @MainActor) — in-app purchase state and entitlement routes
StoreKitManager.EntitlementSweep: private struct — one entitlement check's answer
state: mem:StoreKitManager.isPurchased / hasPurchasedProduct / hasTrialTransaction / product / trialProduct / isPurchasing / errorMessage / purchaseNotice / productsUnavailable / trialUnavailable
toplevel: isPurchased initializer: true when paywallEnabled is false, else UserDefaults storekit.lastKnownPurchased; hasPurchasedProduct initializer: storekit.lastKnownPurchased. isDebugBuild (#if DEBUG true) and isDeveloperInstall (isDebugBuild || ud:storekit.verifiedXcodeInstall) are computed statics that lookup.py does not list as units. debugGrantAccess/hasDebugGrant/debugPurchasedKey are compiled only under #if DEBUG.

flags.text: storekit.verifiedProductionInstall and storekit.verifiedXcodeInstall are not in DataPurgeService's UserDefaults keep list, so Delete All My Data removes them while keeping the anchor. A grandfathered beta tester (isGrandfatheredBetaTester needs verifiedProductionInstall) or verified Xcode install then has no route in until a later boot()'s AppTransaction check rewrites the flag; boot() runs once per process, so in the same process the next refreshStatus computes isPurchased without the bypass.

units.does: Private empty init; all StoreKit wiring is deferred to boot().

Idempotent post-first-frame start: resolves the entitlement anchor across tiers, migrates the legacy TestFlight flag, installs the Transaction.updates listener, kicks off refreshStatus, and starts the background AppTransaction verification. Called from AppLaunchTasks.runDeferredBoot (timedBoot 'storeKitManager').

Outside DEBUG builds, runs EntitlementAnchor.recordHistoryCheck with whether the device already holds sessions — the one-time grandfathering of existing (beta) users. hasHistory nil (history unknown this launch) skips it with a warning so a later launch takes the look. Called from AppLaunchTasks.prepareEntitlementGate, which today passes !collector.archive.index.isEmpty.

flags.text: The caller (AppLaunchTasks.swift:622) still passes !collector.archive.index.isEmpty, read without archiveLock and true-empty when index.json failed to read (indexReadFailed) or to decode (index reset to []); a beta tester whose index is unreadable on the first store-build launch is stamped with hasHistory=false and never re-evaluated. This function now skips the look for hasHistory nil; the archive needs a locked "index complete" accessor and the caller must pass nil when it is false (handed off).

units.does: If the legacy storekit.lastKnownTestFlight flag is true and the cached anchor is not already a beta tester, records the Apple ID as a beta tester in the anchor (both tiers) and logs. Called from AppLaunchTasks.prepareEntitlementGate (before the gate) and from boot().

If the legacy storekit.lastKnownTestFlight flag is true and the cached anchor is not already a beta tester, records the Apple ID as a beta tester in the anchor (both tiers) and logs. Called from AppLaunchTasks.prepareEntitlementGate (before the gate) and from boot().
Cancels the transaction listener task (never runs for the static singleton).
Fetches both products from the App Store and sets product/trialProduct and the unavailable flags; on error marks both unavailable.

branches.effect: productsUnavailable and trialUnavailable set true, error logged

units.does: Buys the lifetime unlock: loads the product if needed (error message when still unavailable) then purchaseProduct. Called from PaywallView purchase button.

branches.effect: sets 'Unable to load product' error and returns; else purchases

units.does: Runs product.purchase() with isPurchasing set, handling the result; user cancel is silent; other errors set a localized failure message.
Handles a purchase result: success → verify, finish transaction, refreshStatus; pending → Ask-to-Buy notice; cancel/unknown → nothing. Unverified throws to the caller.
Starts the free trial by purchasing the $0 trial product (loading it if needed), with isPurchasing set; cancel silent, other errors set 'Purchase failed'. Called from PaywallView start-trial button.

branches.cond: paywall disabled or trial product unavailable

units.does: Handles the trial purchase result: pending → notice; success → verify, record the transaction's purchaseDate as the App Store trial start (anchor + settings), finish, refreshStatus, and if access is still not active tell the user the trial has ended.

branches.effect: sets trial-waiting purchaseNotice (then returns at the next guard)
sets 'free trial has ended' notice; otherwise nothing

units.does: Records the App Store trial start in the anchor (replacing any device start), then mirrors it into synced settings via SettingsManager.adoptTrialStart.

flags.text: A StoreKit static reaches through AppDependencies.current.app.settingsManager to write settings, a hidden dependency on the global container from the purchase path.

units.does: Returns trialProduct, loading products first if needed; sets 'Unable to load product' when still nil.

Restore: AppStore.sync, then one entitlement sweep (sweepAndApply, applied unless superseded) and answers from that sweep via restoreMessage — restored, no purchase found, or could not restore when StoreKit gave no answer; nil on user cancel or paywall off; a failure message on other errors.

Static: the Restore answer for a sweep: 'Could not restore purchases. Please try again.' when StoreKit did not answer, else 'Your purchase has been restored.' or 'No purchase of Emuqu was found for this Apple ID.' by whether it found an entitlement.

Entitlement refresh: with the paywall off sets isPurchased = true; otherwise runs sweepAndApply. Called from boot, purchase/trial handlers, Transaction.updates, AppTransaction verification and AppLaunchTasks.refreshPurchaseEntitlementsInBackground (launch + foreground).
Bumps the refresh generation, awaits an entitlement sweep, applies it only if no newer refresh started meanwhile, and returns the sweep either way.

branches.cond: a newer refresh began while awaiting

units.does: Applies a sweep: adopts any App Store trial start, sets hasTrialTransaction; if StoreKit did not answer keeps the last confirmed purchase (isPurchased = cache || bypass) and logs; otherwise sets hasPurchasedProduct, isPurchased (entitlement || bypass) and persists storekit.lastKnownPurchased.

branches.effect: isPurchased = lastConfirmedPurchase || hasBypassGrant, hasPurchasedProduct untouched, return

units.does: Reads storekit.lastKnownPurchased.

Iterates Transaction.currentEntitlements: marks answered, ORs grantsEntitlement, takes the first trial purchaseDate; if nothing came back, Transaction.latest(for: unlock) also counts as answered (refund case); hasTrialTransaction = trial start found or Transaction.latest(for: trial) exists.

branches.effect: storeKitAnswered = true, entitlement and trial start accumulated
keeps first; otherwise this result's trial date

branches.cond: no entitlements and an unlock transaction exists

branches.effect: hasTrialTransaction = true; else asks Transaction.latest(for: trialProductId)

units.does: Purchase date of a verified trial-product transaction; nil for unverified or other products.

branches.cond: not verified or not the trial product

units.does: True when the verified transaction is the lifetime unlock and not revoked; unverified payloads are logged and count as false.
True for a permanent grant, else (unless -UITests-ForcePaywall) when the trial is active.
Permanent no-purchase grant: DEBUG debug grant; false under -UITests-ForcePaywall; else grandfathered beta tester (production install) or developer install (DEBUG or verified Xcode).
Starts a detached task that for-awaits Transaction.updates and forwards each to finishVerifiedUpdate.
Verifies a transaction update, finishes it and refreshes status; unverified updates are logged and skipped.
units.entry: StoreKit Transaction.updates (refunds, Ask-to-Buy approvals, family sharing changes) via listenForTransactions

branches.effect: logs and skips the update (not finished)

units.does: Whether the free trial is running: TrialPolicy.isActive over trialClock (start, now).
Static: the one resolution of the trial clock — start = anchor cache trial start, else settings.trialStartDate; now = effectiveNow (wall clock, never before the anchor's high-water mark).
Trial start kept on this device: trialClock.start. Only used by hasTrialStarted.
localTrialStart != nil. Read by PaywallView (canStartTrial input and expired-trial copy).
Days left in the trial: TrialPolicy.daysRemaining over trialClock; read by PaywallView.

flags.text: Same computation as SettingsManager.trialDaysRemaining (which the launch gate uses) — the copy is in SettingsManager, outside this file (handed off: it should read StoreKitManager.trialDaysRemaining or a shared resolver).

units.does: isPurchased || hasBypassGrant — access by any route. Read by EmuquApp, PaywallView and AppLaunchTasks.presentPaywallIfNowRequired.

flags.text: AppLaunchTasks.hasAccess is a second derivation of 'access by any route' with different inputs (SettingsManager.isInTrialPeriod instead of isTrialActive, and no DEBUG debug grant), so the launch gate and hasActiveAccess are two copies that must be kept in step.

units.does: hasPurchasedProduct || hasPermanentGrant (no trial). Read by PaywallView and AppLaunchTasks.paywallModal.
Anchored beta tester (cache) AND storekit.verifiedProductionInstall set, via PaywallGatePolicy.grantsBetaTesterAccess.
From a verified AppTransaction environment, sets or clears the verified-Xcode and verified-production flags (unknown environments change nothing).
Sets the key true or removes it.
Environment → production flag: production true, sandbox/xcode false, unknown nil.
Environment → Xcode flag: xcode true, production false, other (sandbox) nil.
Spawns a detached utility task running verifyAppTransactionWithRetries.

Static: tries verifyAppTransaction at 0, 30, 120 and 600 s, stopping at the first attempt AppTransaction answers, so a lookup that fails (offline launch after a reinstall or on a new phone) is retried within the process.

Awaits AppTransaction.shared: verified → record environment flags and refresh entitlement; unverified → set legacy TestFlight flag false; either way returns true. Lookup error → logged, state unchanged, returns false so the caller retries.
DEBUG: sets isPurchased true and persists debug_isPurchased. Called by PaywallView 'Skip (Debug)'.
DEBUG: reads debug_isPurchased.
Unwraps a VerificationResult: returns the value when verified, throws the verification error when unverified.
